title.zh: Bitget clarifies $388M in assets affected by security breach
title.en: Bitget clarifies $388M in assets affected by security breach

current_state.zh: Bitget revised the impact of Thursday's security breach to roughly $388 million in assets transferred to attacker-controlled addresses — about $35 million more than first reported — while continuing to pause withdrawals and launching a bounty to freeze or recover funds.
